nature: READ-ONLY postmortem of the single frozen JM2 2024-25 development run; saved evidence only (no simulation, no refit, no 2025-26)

failed_gate.metric: MIN_CRPS on scored player-games with pregame E[R] >= 10

formal_decision.EXACT_REASON_JM2_WAS_REJECTED: On reservoir-heavy team-games (team opener, almost all November) hard reconciliation shifted the minutes of known players who played downward by 0.75 min (bias -0.31 -> -1.05; MAE +0.088): Phase 1B P(play) expects 8.48 known participants there but 7.65 played, and the 5 x D budget spread the known-player share over too many expected participants. The reservoir level itself was roughly calibrated (44.8 predicted vs 52.3 realized in openers). Worst where E[R] was large but little was missing (582 rows, bias -2.11, CRPS +0.130).

correction_to_JOINT_MINUTES_V2_REPORT: The report attributed the RESERVOIR_HEAVY loss to reservoir variance passed onto known players. The postmortem shows it is primarily a downward MEAN SHIFT created by hard reconciliation interacting with Phase 1B participation-count error: displacement on heavy rows is small (mean 1.48) and the JM2/S0 minutes variance ratio there is 1.005.
JM2_FAILURE_LOCATION: RECONCILIATION (hard budget x independent Phase 1B participation)

residual_j2.STRUCTURAL_MINUTES_DEPENDENCE_SIGNAL: STRONG within player; ABSENT across teammates

bug_review: reservoir labels close: known + out-of-universe minutes = 5 x game minutes within 1 min on 99.7% of team-games
JM1 and JM2 share the same refit; only minutes source and alpha differ

architect_ruling_2026_10_19.champion: S0 / Phase 2 J2 unless a new candidate earns promotion
architect_ruling_2026_10_19.authorized_next: exactly ONE candidate JM1_FINAL = random player-minutes exposure + conditional dispersion refit + residual J2 (the existing JM1 development arm, frozen), one locked retrospective 2025-26 confirmation
